newsitem.title: USA: Burlington gets $600 mln in divestiture.
newsitem.headline: Burlington gets $600 mln in divestiture.

text.p: Burlington Resources Inc said Thursday it has completed its divestiture program announced a year ago, generating proceeds of over $600 million.

In a statement accompanying its second quarter 1997 results, the company said the program eliminated non-strategic oil and gas properties, reduced overall costs and improved its focus on retained core assets.
It said it plans to initiate over 20 exploration wells in the third quarter, part of the 80 wells it expects to drill this year.

"Both earnings and cash flow remain strong and with the completion of the company's divestiture program, we have approximately $500 million in cash and short-term investments," said Bobby Schakouls, president and chief executive of the company.
